from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single legal document relevant to cause-of-action classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the document as it appears in the header or summary")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The stated legal cause of action (案由) in the document, e.g., '产品责任纠纷', '行政纠纷'")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., 判决书，裁定书，决定书)")
    legal_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broader legal nature of the case (e.g., Civil, Administrative) if explicitly stated")
    key_evidence: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt confirming the case cause or nature")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction from all documents in the collection."""
    documents: list[CourtDocument]
